canonical_name: Conditional Event-Level Density / UCM Source Separation
definition: UCM Gate 2 is conditionally closed on one event-level density component. The broad PD-DM-009 and the old density debt PD-DM-003 are narrowed/merged into PD-DM-011.
math: Delta rho_E != 0 and Delta rho_read[u] != 0 => Delta T_U != 0 => P_T(e_full) != P_T(e_vis).
